design_philosophy.core_concept: Digital Atelier - Blending craftsmanship with modern efficiency

visual_style.user_side: Warm, inviting, high-end retail feel. Cream backgrounds, serif typography, generous whitespace.
visual_style.admin_side: Clean, productivity-focused but premium. High contrast, data-dense but not cluttered. Muted status colors.

accent.description: Metallic Gold - Luxury highlight (Buttons, Active States)

user_interface.structure: Single Page App + Modal/Dialogs for interactions
user_interface.spacing: Generous padding (py-16, py-24) to create 'gallery' feel

admin_interface.grid_system: Bento Grid Mode B (High Density) for stats and tables

buttons.primary: bg-[#0F172A] text-white hover:bg-[#1E293B] rounded-none px-6 py-2 uppercase tracking-wider text-sm font-medium transition-all
buttons.accent: bg-[#D4AF37] text-white hover:bg-[#B5952F] rounded-none px-6 py-2 uppercase tracking-wider text-sm font-medium shadow-md hover:shadow-lg transition-all

cards.user_design: bg-white border-none shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300 aspect-[3/4] relative group overflow-hidden
cards.admin_stat: bg-white border border-slate-100 shadow-sm p-6 rounded-lg flex items-center justify-between
cards.admin_table_wrapper: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-lg shadow-sm overflow-hidden

badges.base: inline-flex items-center rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2

icons.usage: Use thin stroke icons (stroke-width={1.5}) for elegance.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text is readable. Use darker grays (slate-700+) on light backgrounds.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus ring on all interactive elements (ring-offset-2 ring-slate-900).

testing.requirement: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute.

universal_guidelines: Do NOT use gradients for backgrounds unless specified.
Maintain the existing 'Navy/Gold' aesthetic for user-facing pages.
Ensure the Admin Dashboard is responsive but optimized for Desktop.
Do not remove existing functionalities while adding new ones.
instructions_to_main_agent:
You are building Phase 2. This involves refactoring App.js into a proper routing structure. 
1. Create a `Layout` component for the admin dashboard. 
2. Create the Admin pages (Login, Dashboard, etc.). 
3. Connect the Admin pages to the Backend API (you will need to assume or create endpoints for these). 
4. Update the User Home page to fetch 'Designs' from the backend instead of hardcoded lists if possible, or prepare it for that integration. 
5. Ensure Authentication state management (store token in localStorage). 
6. STRICTLY follow the 'Quiet Luxury' design guidelines.
